Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class DealFilter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.DealFilter
public record DealFilter(DealState status, ListingType type, String seller, String buyer, LocalDateTime fromDate, LocalDateTime toDate) extends Record
The filter options of the All Deals Record (Task 3.5, step 2). A null field means "no filter on this"; all chosen filters must match. The date range applies to the Start Date shown in the table, inclusive on both ends. Seller and buyer match part of the username, ignoring case.
